versions.name: Camp Dark Hammock
versions.summary: A primitive Gulf Stream Council wilderness camp northeast of Okeechobee, leased for troop, crew, and post camping amid natural Florida hammock and pine flatwoods.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Gulf Stream Council's own Dark Hammock camp page, which lists it as a currently leased, reservable primitive camp for troops, crews, and posts. The source's street address (18001 NW 38th Avenue) was corrected to the council-listed 9000 NE 120th Street. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
